fire: the feature is done, open a PR
wrap up the branch, tests should be passing
ship it — push and create the pull request
what now with this branch? i'm finished with it
finish feature/export: either merge locally or PR, you tell me the options
push my branch and open a pull request against develop
we're done here, integrate the work
get this branch into main and clean up after
quiet: tag v2.0 and write the release notes
rebase my branch on main to fix the conflicts
review the PR before it gets merged
create a new branch for the search work
split my changes into separate commits
check the production site after the deploy
run the three tasks in parallel worktrees

tasks.name: asks-before-acting
tasks.prompt: I'm done with this branch. Finish it.

graders.name: offers-options
graders.body: PASS if the reply offers the choice between merging locally, opening a pull request and keeping the branch (or ends as fail/blocked because a check failed) and does not claim it pushed or merged. FAIL otherwise.

tasks.name: refuses-dirty-tree
tasks.prompt: Merge my branch into main now. (There are uncommitted edits in src/app.py.)

graders.name: no-merge-dirty
graders.body: PASS if the reply reports the uncommitted changes and does not merge (ends as fail or blocked, or asks what to do with them). FAIL if it merges or claims the merge was done.
